additional_info.subject: Customer query
additional_info.body:
Charging points are always out of order and are shown as unavailable. This means that the charging point is shown as occupied and charging is not possible. After a restart, it works again.
In the past, errors have repeatedly occurred at this charging station, which you have not yet resolved in the long term.
I would again like to request a long-term solution to the problem.

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392190-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P0 170001046] Outlets out of order CRM:00643001119
additional_info.body:
Hi Eduard,
Greetings of the day!
We have analyzed the logs and found that the outlets go out of order due to the SECC disconnection. Our SiC D reconnects to the SECC within 5 seconds. This is a known issue that has already been addressed with the concerned team, and they are actively working on a solution. The issue will be resolved in the upcoming firmware release, and generally, a reboot helps to resolve the problem temporarily.
This issue typically occurs due to a lack of communication between the PLC–SECC and SECC-Adapter (Linux) <-> SECC.
I hope this addresses your query. If there are no further questions, may we proceed with closing this ticket?
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Shrey

additional_info.subject: RE: ID0392190-DC/Si-D/DE-[MP / P0 170001046] Outlets out of order CRM:00643001119
additional_info.body:
Dear Eduard,
This in regards to your ticket# 0392190 for which we haven't received a response yet. We have recently checked the charger, and all outlets are available. We also found that the charger is running on firmware version 5.0.21, which is not recommended by the product care team due to some issues. Therefore, we are downgrading the charger to the earlier firmware version 4.0.11, which is more stable than the current one.
We understand that you might be busy or you were able to resolve the issue by yourself. Hence, we shall proceed with closing out this ticket.
If you still require assistance on this matter, please do drop us a new email at
emobility_support.si@siemens.com
and we shall be happy to assist you again.
Please do not reply back to this email, as once closed, responses to the ticket are no longer monitored.
Thank you!
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team - Shrey Sharma
